## Hypothesis

The `STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND` candidate hypothesizes that incorporating a trend-based veto into the entry path can improve the overall performance of the strategy by blocking trades that are counter to the prevailing trend.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves wiring the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function into the entry path to classify the trend as either uptrend, downtrend, or neutral. The veto will block trades that are long in an uptrend or short in a downtrend, while allowing trades that are in line with the trend.
